one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 插件页控制桌面宠物开关
one_liner.en: Control a desktop pet widget from the DSH plugin page

local: macOS app bundle is copied to ~/Applications on first enable; process controls use macOS open, pgrep, and pkill commands.
The plugin stores its enabled preference and log under ~/.dsh.
The bundled widget is a macOS app; the package declares web client injection.
